process_irregularity: Standalone preregistration file was added after the original scaffolding and execution; no post-hoc result changed the arms, thresholds, split, or budget.

arms.hypothesis: A buried accommodation-zone or oblique Walker Lane fault translates magnetic marker horizons without a mapped surface scarp.
arms.transform: Eight oblique directional gradients at non-zero 200-600 m lags, zero-lag registration subtraction, survey-axis downweighting, TC quietness decoupling.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted lithologic/intrusive contact, remanent volcanic polarity, or flight-line/tie-line leveling seam.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: Buried or covered faults can translate a magnetic contact without a mapped Quaternary scarp; catalogue masking is only for holdout/emission control.
arms.novelty: Cross-corridor phase/translation statistic, distinct from existing edge, halo, catalogue-context, GMC, SPBT, gravity-vector, and concentration lanes.
arms.official_data: Pinned 19-band owner mirror; official GeoDAWN and USGS magnetic semantics retained for review

arms.hypothesis: The non-zero-lag magnetic marker translation is useful without TC decoupling.
arms.transform: Same preregistered directional translated-marker response without the TC quietness factor.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contact or survey seam with phase-shifted magnetic response.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: A covered structural offset can be magnetic-only and absent from the visible-fault catalogue.
arms.novelty: Ablation/control isolating the translation signal from radiometric decoupling.
arms.official_data: Pinned 19-band owner mirror; no external layer acquired

arms.hypothesis: A translation-informed response must outperform a conventional magnetic edge control if phase translation is causal.
arms.transform: Directional edge/control response at the same emission budget, without non-zero-lag translation.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: The control is deliberately non-catalogue-dependent but tests whether the claimed buried-fault mechanism adds information beyond edges.
arms.novelty: Preregistered negative control, not a new submission strategy.
arms.official_data: Pinned 19-band owner mirror; no external layer acquired

arms.hypothesis: Signed gravity and basement-depth polarity concordance reveals covered faults with muted surface relief.
arms.transform: Paired signed steps, regularized gravity curvature, long-strike continuity, and relief suppression.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Paleovalley margin, caldera moat wall, or gravity-basement inversion artifact.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: Buried basement faults need not have surface scarps or catalogue traces.
arms.novelty: Distinct future mechanism; not executed in this lane.
arms.official_data: Pinned bands plus official USGS interpretation sources; not executed

promotion: negative unless the candidate beats the preregistered controls with recorded 95% CI, passes leakage, surface/final-dot registry, local format, and selector gates
